Hanoi holds exactly three 1-star Michelin restaurants (all awarded in 2023, all retained through 2025): **Gia** (modern Vietnamese tasting menu, ~$130/person), **Hibana by Koki** (14-seat Japanese teppanyaki inside the Capella hotel, ~$60–110/person), and **Tầm Vị** (traditional Northern Vietnamese home cooking, ~$10–20/person). All three are open Saturday evenings. Note: the 2026 Michelin Guide Vietnam ceremony is 4 June 2026 — two days away — so the list may update imminently.
